setup.title: REA setup
setup.intro: REA connects your AI agent to tools that inspect native binaries, JavaScript and Electron apps, .NET assemblies and websites. Analysis runs locally. Follow the steps on your computer.
needs: The official repo: [github.com/morluto/rea](https://github.com/morluto/rea). A similar repo name does not make a download official.
Node.js with npm: 22.x (22.23.4 or later), 24.x (24.22.1 or later), or 26.12.1 and later. [Get Node.js](https://nodejs.org/en/download).
An agent REA supports, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor.
Only use REA on apps you own or are allowed to inspect.

sections.heading: Route A: ask Claude Code
sections.note: No terminal. Claude Code runs the setup and you approve it.

steps.title: Open Claude Code in a safe folder
steps.body: Use a folder you trust, outside the project you plan to inspect.

steps.title: Paste this prompt
steps.body: It asks for a read-only plan first.

code.text: Run npx -y rea-agents@latest setup --client claude_code --dry-run and show me the plan. If I approve it, run the same command with --yes instead of --dry-run. The official source is github.com/morluto/rea.

steps.title: Review and approve
steps.body: Read what it plans to change before you say yes. Setup backs up existing configuration.

steps.title: Restart Claude Code
steps.body: REA is available after the restart.

sections.heading: Route B: terminal
sections.note: Use this for Codex, Cursor or more than one agent.

steps.title: Check Node.js
steps.body: It should print a version that meets the minimum above.

steps.title: Run setup
steps.body: Run it from a trusted folder outside the project you plan to inspect.

steps.title: Choose and approve
steps.body: Pick your agents, review the proposed changes and approve them. npm's download approval and REA's setup approval are separate.

steps.title: Restart your agents
steps.body: Restart each agent named in the completion message. Using Claude Desktop as an agent? Quit it fully before you approve.

sections.heading: Your first prompt
sections.note: Replace Notes with your app and the feature you want to understand.

steps.title: Ask your agent
steps.body: It inspects the feature, shows the evidence, then builds a version for your project.

code.text: Understand how search works in the Notes app, show me the evidence, and build a similar feature for my project.

tips.title: Stick to official sources.
tips.body: Those are [morluto/rea](https://github.com/morluto/rea), [rea.tools](https://rea.tools/) and the `rea-agents` npm package.

tips.title: Native apps need an engine.
tips.body: Static JavaScript analysis needs none. Native analysis can use Hopper, Ghidra, IDA or Kuna. Setup can install Hopper if you approve it.

tips.title: Stay within your rights.
tips.body: Only inspect apps you own or have permission to analyze.
